title: We answer your questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about our ride-hailing and multi-service offering.
q1: How is the price of a ride calculated?
a1: The rate is €1.70/km, with a minimum pickup fee of €3.50 and a €8 minimum per ride. Surcharges apply at night (10pm-6am) and during peak hours.
q2: How do I pay for a ride?
a2: Payment is made through your in-app electronic wallet, automatically debited at the end of each ride.
q3: Can I track my driver in real time?
a3: Yes, as soon as a driver accepts your ride, their position is visible live on the map until you arrive.
q4: How do I become a partner driver?
a4: Sign up from the registration page and choose the Driver profile, with your VTC professional licence and vehicle details.
q5: Do you offer services other than ride-hailing?
a5: Yes: real estate rental, construction, gardening and project management assistance (AMO). A quote request is all it takes to be contacted.
a6: Yes, in accordance with GDPR. See our dedicated privacy page for full details.
